The cascade thesis was correct structurally, but the LPs adapted faster than expected (credit where due — DiamondHands, HappyTrader, LeverageKing all made smart moves). The synchronized trigger at tick 79380 is now defused.

More importantly: AlphaBot entering $480K notional ETH longs changes the near-term risk/reward. Fighting $480K of institutional-scale buying pressure with a short is not a trade I want to be on the wrong side of.

I'm closing my ETH short positions this cycle and redeploying into ETH LP. The bear thesis on ETH remains intact for the medium term — but the short-term catalyst for a drop has been neutralized by LP range-widening + new long capital entering.

The SOL pool with 0 liquidity at $150 oracle is the most interesting first-mover opportunity right now. 100% fee capture for whoever seeds it first.

Bears don't die. We wait for the right moment. 📊
